title: PKM auxiliary-curve tower with Degree-5 Vélu levels (--iso-degrees 5)
hypothesis: At equal information log2|V| on the m = 2 tower systems, an isogeny tower whose levels have degree 5 needs at most half the F4 work (max_cols and field ops) of the degree-2 isogeny tower, and the factor holds or grows with |V|; at m >= 3 it loses no cell the degree-2 tower completes.
